clips.zh: 请问，洗手间在前面吗？
clips.en: Excuse me, is the restroom up ahead?
notes: 洗手间: 洗 xǐ and 手 shǒu are both third tone, so 洗 rises: xí shǒujiān.
吗 at the end is light and short.

clips.zh: 我坐地铁去机场。
clips.en: I take the subway to the airport.
notes: 地铁 dìtiě: a falling tone, then a third tone that dips.
机场 jīchǎng: the ch is the curled-tongue sound.

clips.zh: 学校离我家很近。
clips.en: The school is close to my home.
notes: 学校 xuéxiào: a rise, then a fall.
近 jìn (close) and 进 jìn (enter) sound the same; the sentence tells you which one it is.

clips.zh: 他每天早上都跑步。
clips.en: He runs every morning.
notes: 每天 měitiān: 每 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
都 dōu is high and flat, and sits before the verb: 都跑步.

clips.zh: 我最喜欢踢足球。
clips.en: I like playing soccer most.
notes: 踢足球: 踢 tī is high and flat, 足 zú and 球 qiú both rise.
喜欢 xǐhuan: 欢 is light.

clips.zh: 他比我高，但是我跑得很快。
clips.en: He is taller than me, but I run fast.
notes: 比我 bǐ wǒ: two third tones in a row, so 比 rises: bí wǒ.
跑得很快 pǎo de hěn kuài: 得 is just a light de.

clips.zh: 因为下雨，所以我们在家看电影。
clips.en: Because it is raining, we watch a movie at home.
notes: 所以 suǒyǐ: two third tones, so 所 rises: suóyǐ.
因为 and 所以 come as a pair: when you hear one, listen for the other.

clips.zh: 你想喝红茶还是绿茶？
clips.en: Do you want black tea or green tea?
notes: 你想 nǐ xiǎng: two third tones, so 你 rises: ní xiǎng.
红茶 hóngchá is "red tea" in Chinese; English calls it black tea.

clips.zh: 我去过两次中国。
clips.en: I have been to China twice.
notes: 去过 qùguo: 过 is light when it shows an experience.
两次 liǎng cì: with a measure word, "two" is 两 liǎng, not 二 èr.

clips.zh: 请你告诉我你的名字。
clips.en: Please tell me your name.
notes: 请你 qǐng nǐ: two third tones, so 请 rises: qíng nǐ.
告诉 gàosu: 诉 is light.

clips.zh: 她教我们汉语。
clips.en: She teaches us Chinese.
notes: 教 jiāo (to teach) is high and flat; 叫 jiào (to be called) falls. They are easy to mix up.
们 in 我们 is light.

clips.zh: 门开着，请进来。
clips.en: The door is open; please come in.
notes: 开着 kāizhe: 着 is light here.
进来 jìnlái: 进 falls, 来 rises.

clips.zh: 我已经吃完饭了。
clips.en: I have already finished eating.
notes: 已经 yǐjīng: 已 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
了 at the end is light; it shows the eating is finished.

clips.zh: 别走，再坐一会儿。
clips.en: Do not go; sit a little longer.
notes: 别 bié (do not) rises; 比 bǐ (than) dips.
一会儿 yíhuìr: 一 changes to yí before the fourth tone 会.

clips.zh: 老师让我们别说话。
clips.en: The teacher asks us not to talk.
notes: 老师 lǎoshī: 老 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
别说话 bié shuōhuà: rising, high, then falling.

clips.zh: 这个电影很有意思。
clips.en: This movie is very interesting.
notes: 很有 hěn yǒu: two third tones, so 很 rises: hén yǒu.
意思 yìsi: 思 is light.

clips.zh: 我的手机在桌子上面。
clips.en: My phone is on the table.
notes: 手机 shǒujī: 手 is a third tone before a first tone, so it only dips.
桌子 zhuōzi: 子 is light.

clips.zh: 我不想出国，我想在家休息。
clips.en: I do not want to go abroad; I want to rest at home.
notes: 不想 bù xiǎng: 不 stays fourth tone before a third tone; it changes only before another fourth tone.
出国 chūguó: high and flat, then rising.

clips.zh: 他个子很高，打篮球打得很好。
clips.en: He is tall and plays basketball very well.
notes: 个子 gèzi: 子 is light.
打篮球 dǎ lánqiú: 打 dips, 篮 and 球 both rise.

clips.zh: 从我家到车站走路要十分钟。
clips.en: It takes ten minutes to walk from my home to the station.
notes: 车站 chēzhàn: both the ch and the zh are curled-tongue sounds.
从…到… means from … to …: you hear 从 first and 到 later.

clips.zh: 他经常和朋友一起去游泳。
clips.en: He often goes swimming with friends.
notes: 一起 yìqǐ: 一 is yì before the third tone 起.
朋友 péngyou: 友 is light.

clips.zh: 今天是晴天，我们出去玩吧。
clips.en: Today is sunny; let us go out and play.
notes: 晴天 qíngtiān: a rise, then high and flat.
吧 at the end is light and invites agreement.

clips.zh: 虽然很累，但是我很高兴。
clips.en: Although I am tired, I am happy.
notes: 虽然 suīrán: 虽 is high and flat, 然 rises.
但是 dànshì: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 他可能不在家，你给他打电话吧。
clips.en: He may not be at home; you should call him.
notes: 可能 kěnéng: 可 is a third tone before a rising tone, so it only dips.
打电话 dǎ diànhuà: 打 dips, then two falling tones.

clips.zh: 你的生日是几月几号？
clips.en: What month and day is your birthday?
notes: 生日 shēngrì: high and flat, then falling.
几月 jǐ yuè and 几号 jǐ hào: 几 only dips before a falling tone.

clips.zh: 我弟弟比我小两岁。
clips.en: My younger brother is two years younger than me.
notes: 两岁 liǎng suì: with a measure word, "two" is 两 liǎng, not 二 èr.
弟弟 dìdi: the second syllable is light and short.

clips.zh: 这件衣服很便宜，我想买两件。
clips.en: This piece of clothing is cheap; I want to buy two.
notes: 便宜 piányi: the last syllable is light and short.
两件 liǎng jiàn: 两 is a third tone before a fall, so it only dips.

clips.zh: 你喜欢看书还是看电视？
clips.en: Do you like reading books or watching TV?
notes: 还是 háishi: 还 is said hái here (or), and 是 is light.
看书 kàn shū: a fall, then high and flat.

clips.zh: 请问，我去火车站怎么走？
clips.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
notes: 怎么 zěnme: 么 is light and short.
火车站 huǒchēzhàn: a dip, a high tone, then a fall.

clips.zh: 我昨天晚上睡得很晚。
clips.en: I went to bed very late last night.
notes: 晚上 wǎnshang: 上 is light and short.
睡得很晚 shuì de hěn wǎn: 得 is light; 很晚 are two third tones, so 很 rises: hén wǎn.

clips.zh: 我有一个哥哥和两个姐姐。
clips.en: I have one older brother and two older sisters.
notes: 一个 yí ge: 一 is said yí before the fourth tone, and 个 is light.
两个 liǎng ge: 两 dips, and 个 is light.

clips.zh: 他在商店买了一本书。
clips.en: He bought a book at the shop.
notes: 一本 yì běn: 一 is said yì before the third tone 本.
买了 mǎi le: 买 dips, and 了 is light.

clips.zh: 外面下雨了，我们别出去了。
clips.en: It has started to rain outside, so let us not go out.
notes: 外面 wàimiàn: both syllables fall.
别出去了 bié chūqù le: 别 rises, 出去 is high and flat then falling, and 了 is light.

clips.zh: 你们几点下课？我们四点下课。
clips.en: What time do you finish class? We finish class at four.
notes: 下课 xiàkè: both syllables fall.
几点 jǐ diǎn: two third tones, so 几 rises: jí diǎn.

clips.zh: 我家在医院旁边，离学校不远。
clips.en: My home is next to the hospital, and not far from the school.
notes: 旁边 pángbiān: a rise, then high and flat.
不远 bù yuǎn: 不 stays bù before a third tone.

clips.zh: 他唱歌唱得很好听。
clips.en: He sings very nicely.
notes: 唱歌 chàng gē: a fall, then high and flat.
好听 hǎotīng: 好 only dips before the high 听.

clips.zh: 我想吃一个面包，再喝一杯牛奶。
clips.en: I want to eat a piece of bread and then drink a glass of milk.
notes: 一个 yí ge: 一 is said yí before the fourth tone, and 个 is light.
一杯 yì bēi: 一 is said yì before the high tone 杯.

clips.zh: 你明天想做什么？
clips.en: What do you want to do tomorrow?
notes: 明天 míngtiān: a rise, then high and flat.
做什么 zuò shénme: a fall, a rise, then a light 么.

clips.zh: 他跑得比我快，但是我游得比他快。
clips.en: He runs faster than me, but I swim faster than him.
notes: 比他 bǐ tā: 比 only dips before the high 他.
游得 yóu de: a rise, then a light de.

clips.zh: 我已经给你打了三次电话。
clips.en: I have already called you three times.
notes: 给你 gěi nǐ: two third tones in a row, so 给 rises: géi nǐ.
三次 sān cì: high and flat, then falling.

clips.zh: 你要多喝水，少喝咖啡。
clips.en: You need to drink more water and less coffee.
notes: 少喝 shǎo hē: 少 only dips before the high 喝.
咖啡 kāfēi: both syllables are high and flat.

clips.zh: 我觉得今天的菜很好吃。
clips.en: I think the food today is delicious.
notes: 觉得 juéde: 觉 is said jué here (to feel), a rise, and 得 is light.
好吃 hǎochī: 好 only dips before the high 吃.

clips.zh: 妈妈在做饭，爸爸在看电视。
clips.en: Mom is cooking and Dad is watching TV.
notes: 在 zài before a verb shows the action is going on: 在做饭, 在看电视.
电视 diànshì: both syllables fall.

clips.zh: 我的手表慢了五分钟。
clips.en: My watch has gone five minutes slow.
notes: 手表 shǒubiǎo: two third tones, so 手 rises: shóubiǎo.
五分钟 wǔ fēnzhōng: 五 only dips before the high 分.

clips.zh: 我们八点在学校门口见面。
clips.en: We will meet at the school gate at eight.
notes: 见面 jiàn miàn: both syllables fall.
学校 xuéxiào: a rise, then a fall.

clips.zh: 你知道那个人是谁？
clips.en: Do you know who that person is?
notes: 知道 zhīdào: high and flat, then falling.
谁 shéi: a rise.

clips.zh: 我的朋友在中国学习汉语。
clips.en: My friend studies Chinese in China.
notes: 中国 Zhōngguó: a high tone, then a rise.
汉语 hànyǔ: a fall, then a dip.

clips.zh: 他的眼睛很大，个子也很高。
clips.en: His eyes are very big, and he is tall too.
notes: 眼睛 yǎnjing: the last syllable is light and short.
很大 hěn dà: 很 only dips before the falling 大.
